title: Understanding Agglomerative Clustering
text: Agglomerative clustering starts with each point as its own cluster and merges the closest clusters step by step until the desired number of clusters is reached.

title: Distance Criterion
text: The distance between clusters is determined by the maximum distance between points from each cluster. This is known as complete linkage.

title: Finding the Closest Clusters
text: Look at the distance matrix. Identify the pair of clusters with the smallest distance between them.

title: Identify the Closest Pair
text: Which pair of points has the smallest distance between them?

title: Merging Clusters
text: After identifying the closest pair, merge them into a single cluster. The new cluster is named after the lowest letter in the pair.
